title: Product-site sheaves are diagrams of sheaves
statement: For small categories J,C, a topology K on C, and a topology T on J^op × C with the vertical covering-sieve criterion [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-topology], there is an equivalence E from set sheaves on T to J-diagrams of set sheaves on K. It sends F to j ↦ F restricted to the vertical slice j, sends horizontal arrows to the corresponding restrictions of F, and sends morphisms to their components. For each j, E followed by evaluation has right adjoint evaluationRightAdjoint(j) followed by the inverse equivalence, and preserves finite limits.

proof.text: Curry product presheaves into vertical component presheaves; horizontal restrictions give the diagram maps. Uncurry a diagram using horizontal transport followed by vertical restriction. Naturality and the factorization of product arrows prove the functor laws.

proof.text: The componentwise sheaf criterion restricts both functors to sheaves. Construct the unit and counit with identity maps on sections; their naturality follows from product-arrow factorization and the diagram laws. The triangle identity holds sectionwise.
